# [C6 — Water temperature and solubility](../hypodrafts/C6.md "Water temperature and solubility")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_c6.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Draft, not a result.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it. The counts it prints are read from held outputs.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What is not in dispute

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-CEILING">Oxygen solubility is a function of temperature and salinity (and of pressure), computed from published equations; Weiss (1970) proposed the set this draft uses. That half of [C6](../hypodrafts/C6.md "Water temperature and solubility") needs no test.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-CEILING "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-RESIDUE">The testable residue is the Q10 half: **at constant organic supply, does warmer bottom water sit further below its own ceiling?**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-RESIDUE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The observable consequence, stated so it can be falsified

Define the near-bed apparent deficit, per station-month:

> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-DEF">`D = C_sat(T_bed, S_bed) − O_bed` (mg/l), with `C_sat` from Weiss's equations in ml/l, converted at [1.42905](../SOURCES.md#F-dd36b0529d) mg per ml.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-DEF "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NEUTRAL">`D` is solubility-neutral by construction: if temperature acted on near-bed oxygen *only* through the ceiling, `D` would not depend on `T`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NEUTRAL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-FALSIFY">**What would falsify it:** *within a fixed station and a fixed calendar month, across years, `D` does not rise with that year's near-bed temperature* — a pooled within-cell slope β̂ that is not positive, or one the permutation null below cannot tell from none. That falsifies [C6](../hypodrafts/C6.md "Water temperature and solubility")'s non-thermodynamic content at the resolution this archive has.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-FALSIFY "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-SUBSID">**Subsidiary, about the iltsvind threshold:** *the `< 4 mg/l` flag ranks stations by consumption, not by ceiling height.* Falsified if station-level flag rates under `O < 4` and under a deficit flag with the same overall rate rank stations differently.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-SUBSID "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The data held

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-SERIES">`docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}` holds [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-7769a94f7a) station-months — the sum over its [9](../SOURCES.md#F-cb09ee93d7) variables — at [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-d519303f1a) stations, in [564](../SOURCES.md#F-f27c348866) monthly slots from January [1980](../SOURCES.md#F-44433af5f2). Near-bed: `oxy_bed` [76,980](../SOURCES.md#F-e4779c5760) · `temp_bed` [84,656](../SOURCES.md#F-627274f1a2) · `sal_bed` [83,309](../SOURCES.md#F-8a4e8ec0a0) · `oxysat_bed` [64,493](../SOURCES.md#F-ed417b4b5a).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-SERIES "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-JOIN-NORUN">No script here joins the three near-bed arrays, so how many station-months carry all three, how many pass the plausibility filter, and how many cells have enough years are not known.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-JOIN-NORUN "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**What is wrong with the data, and what the test does about it.**

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-FLAGS">**Impossible values.** The panel holds values no water can hold — the flag record marks the sign-inverted oxygen of May and June 2005 — so the plausibility filter comes before anything else.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-FLAGS "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-QUANT">**Quantisation.** Raw `Temperatur` is written with at most one decimal on [1,076,874](../SOURCES.md#F-5bb29588ed) of [7,501,421](../SOURCES.md#F-a33f8c08bd) rows of the whole CTD extract ([14](../SOURCES.md#F-b87ceb99d3)%); how much that rounding moves `C_sat` has not been computed here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-QUANT "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-AGG">**Aggregation.** These are monthly *medians*, `_bed` is the deepest quarter of each cast's depth range, and each variable's median is taken separately, so the T, S and O medians of one station-month need not come from the same cast.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-AGG "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-UNFILLED">**Unfilled.** At least [12,487](../SOURCES.md#F-da36d9a0d9) `oxy_bed` station-months carry no saturation — the difference of the two counts, a lower bound — and `SondeNr` is `999`, probe unknown, on [25.6](../SOURCES.md#F-18d47162ce)% of the CTD extract.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-UNFILLED "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NOCLOCK">**No time of day.** The raw header (`data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz`, [34](../SOURCES.md#F-6c253b945d) columns) has `Dato` as `19701013` — a date, no hour — and no other time field.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NOCLOCK "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-HOUR">Within a station and calendar month, where the test works, the season's pull on the hour of sampling is held fixed; what remains is any change in that hour from year to year, which the detrending absorbs only where it is a trend. It is not correctable from this archive, and it caps what any result licenses.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-HOUR "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NOWB">**The unit is a station, never a water body.**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NOWB "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Circularity, handled

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NOTOUTCOME">The archive's `oxysat_bed` is **never the outcome here**: saturation is oxygen as a share of what the water can hold at its temperature, so regressing it on temperature would put temperature on both sides.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NOTOUTCOME "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-SATSRC">How ODA computes the saturation it supplies — `Oxygenmætning`, a parameter of its own in the CTD extract — is not documented in anything held or pinned here, so whether it rests on the same equations as `C_sat` is not known.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-SATSRC "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-DELIBERATE">`D` contains T through `C_sat` deliberately — that is the *removal* of the solubility channel, not circularity, because `C_sat` is a fixed published function, not fitted to these data.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-DELIBERATE "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-USGS">The U.S. Geological Survey has replaced Weiss's equations with those of Benson and Krause for its own oxygen work.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-USGS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-EIV">The residual risk is errors-in-variables: an error ε in T enters `D` through `C_sat`, which falls as temperature rises, and enters the regressor unchanged, so it pulls β̂ toward a **negative** value as well as toward none. The test is therefore conservative in the direction that matters. Salinity, derived from conductivity and temperature, carries temperature error too; the size of either effect has not been computed here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-EIV "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-P1">Read the three near-bed arrays at the offsets in the `.json`; key on `station_index × 1000 + month_index`; keep [0](../SOURCES.md#F-44b150c62f) ≤ O ≤ [20](../SOURCES.md#F-93848b93bd) mg/l, [−2](../SOURCES.md#F-b5209874b6) ≤ T ≤ [30](../SOURCES.md#F-b0c4aba8b0) °C and [0](../SOURCES.md#F-b21f94aa9f) ≤ S ≤ [40](../SOURCES.md#F-c0c6ee0e4f), and report what the filter removes.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-P1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-P2">Compute `C_sat` and `D`. Keep cells with at least [8](../SOURCES.md#F-d290efb8d8) distinct years.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-P2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-P3">Centre T and D on their cell means. Estimate β̂ = Σ(t̃·d̃)/Σ(t̃²) — the station × calendar-month fixed-effects slope of deficit on temperature, mg/l per °C.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-P3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-P4">**Null, computed under the constraint actually imposed.** [2,000](../SOURCES.md#F-ddd486da04) permutations: within each cell independently, permute D across years with T held in place. This keeps cell means, the seasonal cycle, every station effect and both marginals, destroying only the within-cell T–D pairing. Two-sided p = fraction with |β*| ≥ |β̂|. Report the permutation SD *and* the OLS SE and their ratio: near-bed deficits at neighbouring stations in the same month can be the same water mass sampled twice, so the textbook SE assumes an independence the data need not have. That ratio is the size of the error a quoted null would have made.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-P4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
5. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-P5">Repeat with D linearly detrended on year within each cell, so that a trend temperature and deficit share across the years cannot manufacture β̂. Report both, and the variants with at least [3](../SOURCES.md#F-dba2ee11be) and at least [10](../SOURCES.md#F-9d8de7883a) years.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-P5 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
6. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-P6">Subsidiary: per station, the flag rate under `O < 4` and under a deficit threshold set so that it flags the same share of station-months; Spearman ρ over the stations; count the stations flagged by one and not the other. Null: permute calendar-month labels within station.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-P6 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
7. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-P7">Confirmatory version, if step 4 clears: rebuild `D` from the temperature, salinity and oxygen of the *same cast* by streaming the CTD extract, removing the pairing gap that monthly medians leave.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-P7 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What a result would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-WOULD">**Would.** A positive β̂ surviving the permutation null and the detrending licenses: near-bed temperature moves near-bed oxygen beyond solubility, within station and within calendar month, in this archive — the gap [C6](../hypodrafts/C6.md "Water temperature and solubility") names, since the standing statistical models carry surface temperature only.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-WOULD "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NOTRESP">**Would not.** It does not identify respiration: DCE name wind mixing as slowing oxygen depletion and high temperature as promoting it, and a warm year can also be a calm one, so a larger deficit may be failed ventilation rather than Q10.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NOTRESP "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NOQ10">It cannot calibrate Q10 at all: converting a respiration *rate* to a standing deficit needs a ventilation timescale this archive does not record.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NOQ10 "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NOWBODY">It says nothing about water bodies.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NOWBODY "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-CC-C6-NULLRES">And a slope indistinguishable from none would **not** refute [C6](../hypodrafts/C6.md "Water temperature and solubility") in nature; it would refute it at the resolution of monthly medians taken at an unrecorded hour.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-CC-C6-NULLRES "What this claim rests on")</sup>
